'''ACC-7''' was a model of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] produced by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] during the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Their spherical body contained a standard [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engine for propulsion, and advanced [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]] were attached to each of its four retractable arms for use in combat. The ACC-7 saw widespread usage among [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] spies during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The use of ACC-7's was later outlawed, however, by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Many were brought back into commission for use against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].
